parameters.query:
INSERT INTO chinmay_astro.messages (
  user_id,
  consultation_id,
  direction,
  message_type,
  content,
  whatsapp_message_id,
  metadata,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6,
  $7::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;
SELECT id, current_consultation_id FROM chinmay_astro.users WHERE phone_number = $1 LIMIT 1;
